title: Senior Product Manager, Finance Technology (Procure-to-Pay & Record-to-Report)
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

 Join our Finance Applications team as a Senior Product Manager focused on Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Record-to-Report (R2R). You will own the product roadmap and delivery for the systems and capabilities that support procurement, accounts payable, general ledger, close, consolidation, and financial reporting. Your portfolio will include platforms such as Zip, Coupa, Ramp, NetSuite, Workiva, and related integrations and data products.

 At Reddit, you will partner with Finance, Accounting, Procurement, Engineering, and business systems teams to turn complex operational needs into scalable, secure, and well-controlled solutions. You will lead discovery, prioritize the backlog, define requirements, and guide initiatives from concept through launch and adoption.

 Success in this role requires strong finance process knowledge, sound product judgment, and the ability to move between strategy and execution. You will bring structure to ambiguous problems, make clear tradeoffs, and deliver measurable improvements in efficiency, controls, data quality, and the employee experience.
